properties.description:
Monitors data ingestion for low-priority tables.
Query to display recent events:

let _step = 12h;
let lookback = 8d;
union isfuzzy=true
AzureActivity,
AlertInfo,
AlertEvidence,
AADRiskyUsers,
EmailAttachmentInfo,
AuditLogs,
SigninLogs,
AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs,
DeviceEvents,
DeviceFileCertificateInfo,
DeviceFileEvents,
DeviceImageLoadEvents,
DeviceInfo,
DeviceNetworkEvents,
DeviceNetworkInfo,
DeviceProcessEvents,
DeviceRegistryEvents,
EmailPostDeliveryEvents,
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs,
AADProvisioningLogs,
EmailAttachmentInfo'
UrlClickEvents,
OfficeActivity
| make-series count() default=0 on TimeGenerated from bin(ago(lookback),_step) to bin(now(),_step) step _step by Type
| render  timechart
properties.query:
// Service Ticket #4067293 - Tables stopped logging
// LOW: compare the latest 24 hours with the previous baseline of 7days
let slot_duration = 12h;
let check_slots = 2;
let full_slots = 14 + check_slots;
let baseline_slots = full_slots - check_slots;
let enough_slots = toint(baseline_slots/2); // At least 50% slots are needed to calculate the baseline
// raise an alert if the average of the latest slots is smaller by 90% (1-0.1) of the MINIMUM value from the baseline
let threshold_percentage = 0.1;
/////////////////////////////////////////////////////
let currenttime = now(); // - 1h; //datetime(2025-03-18T13:00:00Z); // useful for debugging
let full_time = full_slots * slot_duration;
let check_time = check_slots * slot_duration;
let full_start = bin(currenttime - full_time, slot_duration); // Round the start time to the nearest full slot time
let full_now = bin(currenttime, slot_duration); // Round the end time to the nearest full slot time
let AnalysedTables =  (datatable(Type:string) [
    "AzureActivity",
    "AlertInfo",
    "AlertEvidence",
    "AADRiskyUsers",
    "EmailAttachmentInfo",
    "AADProvisioningLogs",
    "AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs",
    "AuditLogs",
    "DeviceEvents",
    "DeviceFileCertificateInfo",
    "DeviceFileEvents",
    "DeviceImageLoadEvents",
    "DeviceInfo",
    "DeviceLogonEvents",
    "DeviceNetworkEvents",
    "DeviceNetworkInfo",
    "DeviceProcessEvents",
    "DeviceRegistryEvents",
    "EmailPostDeliveryEvents",
    "OfficeActivity",
    "SigninLogs",
    "UrlClickEvents",
    "AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs"	
]);
let t_slot_counts = union isfuzzy=true
    (AzureActivity        | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (AlertInfo       | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (AlertEvidence        | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (AADRiskyUsers        | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (EmailAttachmentInfo       | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (AADProvisioningLogs          | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (AuditLogs                    | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (DeviceEvents                 | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (DeviceFileCertificateInfo    | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (DeviceFileEvents             | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (DeviceImageLoadEvents        | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (DeviceInfo                   | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (DeviceLogonEvents            | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (DeviceNetworkEvents          | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (DeviceNetworkInfo            | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (DeviceProcessEvents          | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (DeviceRegistryEvents         | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (EmailPostDeliveryEvents      | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (OfficeActivity               | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (SigninLogs                   | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (UrlClickEvents               | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs| where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (datatable()[]);
let t_baseline_raw = t_slot_counts | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. (full_now - check_time -1ms)); // baseline considers all the slots excluding the ones in the check_time time window
let t_baseline_filter_enough_slots = (t_baseline_raw | summarize slots = count() by Type)
| join t_baseline_raw on Type
| where slots > enough_slots; // Ignore if we do not have enough data points
let t_baseline = t_baseline_filter_enough_slots
| summarize count_baseline = min(count_slot) by Type; // and then takes the slot with the LOWEST value
let t_check = t_slot_counts
| where TimeGenerated >= full_now - check_time  // Slots to check: considers all the slots in the check_time time window
| summarize count_check = toint(avg(count_slot)) by Type; // and then takes the average of these slots
// Now join with the static AnalysedTables to ensure that even tables with completely missing entries are reported
let t_output = AnalysedTables
| join kind=fullouter (t_baseline) on Type
| join kind=fullouter (t_check) on Type
| extend count_baseline = coalesce(count_baseline, 0), count_check = coalesce(count_check, 0)
//| order by case(count_baseline == 0, 1, 0) asc, Type asc // this is just for easier debugging
// Alert if the current average is lower than X% of the lowest baseline slot
| where count_baseline > 0 and count_check < max_of(1,round(threshold_percentage * count_baseline,0));
// Add a column with the list of affected tables per customer
let t_affectedtables = t_output | summarize AffectedTables=array_strcat(todynamic(make_set(Type,100)),",");
t_output | extend OtherAffectedTables = toscalar(t_affectedtables)
| project Table=Type, count_baseline, count_check, OtherAffectedTables, TimeSlot = full_now
